about.heading: About Me
about.paragraph1: I am Paula Sevarolli, stylist and fashion designer with a deep passion for creativity, fashion, and aesthetics. As a Brazilian with Italian roots, I have lived in Brazil, Italy, Germany, and the Czech Republic. These experiences have deeply shaped my perspective on style, culture, and individuality.
about.paragraph2: I completed my Master’s degree in Fashion Design at the IED in Florence, Italy, and further specialized as a style consultant. Over the years, I gained experience across various sectors of the fashion industry. This combination of academic study, hands-on practice, and personal growth defines my work today.
about.paragraph3: As a mother and woman who has navigated life changes, body transformations, and cultural transitions firsthand, I know how closely style is tied to self-image – and how challenging it can be to redefine yourself in certain moments.
about.paragraph4: I work with people going through these exact transitions: after pregnancy, entering a new professional role, or adjusting to a new culture. My approach is deliberately personal and practical – free from rigid rules or short-lived trends.
about.paragraph5: I view fashion as a subtle yet powerful tool for self-expression. A harmonious style is not built on perfection, but on clarity, self-knowledge, and feeling comfortable in your own skin. With a trained eye for colors, cuts, shapes, and proportions, I help you craft an authentic style tailored to your daily life.
about.paragraph6: Whether it is a wardrobe reset, personal shopping, color analysis, or individual style consulting – I am here to guide you toward greater clarity, confidence, and comfort in your style.
about.paragraph7: Because style truly begins when you recognize yourself.

stilberatungPage.aboutText1: I’ll help you put together a wardrobe that’s authentic and versatile and supports you through every stage of life. My approach focuses on expressing each client’s inner identity through her clothing, rather than relying on fashion rules.
stilberatungPage.aboutText2: I’ll help you navigate life transitions—such as a new career, motherhood, or moving to a new country—by tailoring your look to who you are right now.

wardrobeReset.title: Wardrobe Reset
wardrobeReset.intro: Together, we'll organize your closet and bring some clarity. You'll keep only what truly fits your current lifestyle, your style, and your body—everything else can go. For more ease and a clearer overview in your everyday life.
wardrobeReset.listItem1: organizing by color, fit, and function
wardrobeReset.detailIntro: For anyone who wants more clarity, order, and ease in their wardrobe.
wardrobeReset.detailText1: Perhaps you know the feeling: your wardrobe is full, yet you feel you have nothing to wear. Between unworn clothes, bad purchases, pieces saved for someday, and old favorites, it is hard to see the bigger picture.
wardrobeReset.detailText2: This is where we begin. We look at your wardrobe piece by piece and decide honestly and without pressure what stays, what can be altered or newly combined, and what you want to let go of.
wardrobeReset.detailText3: We consider your taste, but especially your current life, daily routine, body, and personal style.
wardrobeReset.detailText4: Together, we optimize your wardrobe, find the right proportions between tops and bottoms, and reorganize everything so all pieces are visible and practical.
wardrobeReset.detailList1: What do you really enjoy wearing regularly?
wardrobeReset.detailList2: Which clothes suit your current daily life?
wardrobeReset.detailList3: What suits you and makes you feel comfortable?
wardrobeReset.detailList5: Which important basics might be missing?
wardrobeReset.detailList6: Which clothes stay only because you do not want to part with them?
wardrobeReset.detailText5: You receive an honest, appreciative outside perspective. The aim is to shop more consciously and shorten your mornings in front of the mirror. Your wardrobe should become clearer, more cohesive, and practical.

colorConsultation.title: Color Analysis
colorConsultation.intro: We'll help you discover the colors that are right for you—colors that make you look fresh, vibrant, and authentic. You'll learn which shades bring out your natural radiance—giving you more confidence when shopping and putting together outfits.
colorConsultation.listItem1: more confidence when shopping and pairing outfits
colorConsultation.listItem2: a clearer understanding of your personal color palette
colorConsultation.detailIntro: Discover the colors that enhance your natural radiance.
colorConsultation.detailText1: Colors strongly influence our look. We are all born with a personal combination of skin, hair, eyelash, eyebrow, and lip colors. Clothing, makeup, accessories, and hair colors should harmonize with it.
colorConsultation.detailText2: The right shades even out your skin, highlight your eyes, and create a rested, youthful appearance. Others can make you look pale, emphasize dark circles, and make you look tired.
colorConsultation.detailText3: In the personal analysis, we identify temperature, contrast, and intensity and find the palette that harmonizes best with you.
colorConsultation.detailText4: You receive your personal 12-season color palette in print as practical guidance for shopping and building your wardrobe.
colorConsultation.detailText5: Your key colors are always at hand. You learn to choose and combine them consciously and see which garments make the biggest difference. No rigid rules, only better awareness.

personalShopping.title: Personal Shopping & Styling
personalShopping.intro: Together, we’ll find clothes that are just right for you—instead of making bad purchases and feeling frustrated. You’ll get honest, stylish guidance while shopping, tailored to your everyday life, your body type, and your personal style.
personalShopping.meta: 2–4 hours / R$ 1,100 + R$ 480 per additional hour
personalShopping.listItem1: a curated selection tailored to your daily routine
personalShopping.listItem2: styling tips for confident outfit combinations
personalShopping.detailIntro: Shop with purpose instead of searching for hours and still finding nothing suitable.
personalShopping.detailText1: Shopping can be fun, but also tiring and frustrating. Too many options, different cuts, trends, and the question “Does this really suit me?” make decisions difficult.
personalShopping.detailText2: With Personal Shopping, I accompany you and help you find clothes that truly fit your life, style, figure, wishes, and budget.
personalShopping.detailText3: The goal is not to buy many clothes, but to shop consciously and find key pieces that complement your wardrobe and combine well.
personalShopping.detailList2: which materials and silhouettes suit you,
personalShopping.detailText4: I show you how to recognize good materials and construction and when to invest. You do not need to force yourself into trends. Your style should follow you. The aim is a comfortable wardrobe that fits your life and offers easy outfit options.
personalShopping.detailText5: You do not need to change who you are or force yourself into something just because it is fashionable. Your style should follow you, not the other way around. The aim is a wardrobe that feels good, fits your life, and offers many easy outfit options.

individualConsultation.title: Individual Style Consulting
individualConsultation.intro: We'll help you develop your personal style based on your personality, lifestyle, and body type. You'll understand what truly defines you—and how to express that through your clothing.
individualConsultation.listItem2: a clear strategy for your wardrobe and routine
individualConsultation.detailIntro: Our appearance is an important form of communication, even when we do not notice it.
individualConsultation.detailText1: Before we speak, our appearance communicates seriousness, professionalism, personality, accessibility, authority, and lifestyle.
individualConsultation.detailText2: Dressing well goes beyond trends and beautiful clothes. The image we convey may not reflect who we are, our personality, daily life, or current stage of life. Style must make sense, be practical and functional, and reflect your identity.
individualConsultation.detailText3: Developing a style concept is a process of self-awareness and analysis. We understand your preferences, needs, goals, priorities, and daily life and turn them into a coherent, authentic, strategic appearance.
individualConsultation.detailText4: The goal is clarity and independence, so you know not only what to wear, but why certain choices work for you.
individualConsultation.detailList1: understand the image you want to convey,
individualConsultation.detailList2: discover colors that highlight your beauty,
individualConsultation.detailList3: learn to choose cuts and fits for your body,
individualConsultation.detailList4: build a cohesive, versatile, functional wardrobe,
individualConsultation.detailList5: receive tools for conscious, confident shopping.
individualConsultation.detailText5: Individual style consulting is a comprehensive process including services such as personal color analysis, wardrobe analysis, and Personal Shopping.
individualConsultation.detailText6: We develop an exclusive style concept based on your personality, daily life, goals, and preferences. The consultation changes not only your wardrobe, but also your relationship with it, so your appearance aligns with who you are.
individualConsultation.detailText7: The consultation aims not only to transform your wardrobe, but above all your relationship with it: to dress more consciously, confidently, and effortlessly, so your appearance truly reflects who you are.
